title: tabebuia pisoniana
intro: Tabebuia pisoniana, commonly known as White Teak, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It is a deciduous tree that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Tabebuia pisoniana include lapachol, beta-lapachone, and naphthoquinones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antitumor activities. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine and modern pharmaceutical applications.
